_about: Values New Recruit prints otherwise than GW's datasheet, for catalogued datasheets no committed export or PDF of the owner's shows (those it does show are in verify/deviations-nr.json). An import that shows New Recruit's value here is built with GW's value and a note naming both (the owner's standing decision, as for points); any other unexplained value is refused. gw: GW's value, which must be the DATASHEETS row's (verify/build-index.js fails otherwise; verify/numbers.js holds the row to the Wahapedia datasheet page). nr: New Recruit's value, recorded before 22 Nov 2026 from New Recruit's data (once verify/deviations-bsdata.json, army catalog); it cannot be re-checked until an export of the owner's shows the datasheet, and an entry whose nr an export contradicts should be corrected from that export.
